subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Japanese marine engineering and shipbuilding, entries 31–39
subfiles.about: An administrative index summarizes and cross-references nine papers dated 1930–1939 concerning commercial and naval shipbuilding in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Entries 31-34 cover proposed shipbuilder consolidation, unprofitable yards, withheld tonnage data, and construction-stage tables; entries 35-39 cover Osaka Shosen's Kawasaki shares purchase, 1939 shipbuilding laws, subsidies, loan relief, and a naval attaché's report on battleship construction.

interest: Tracks 1930s Japanese shipbuilding consolidation, subsidies, secrecy, and possible battleship construction.
